coast.prompt:
Make one targeted correction to this existing hilly fantasy kingdom at dusk: there are far too many outdoor torches and orange light points.
Remove nearly all outdoor torches, braziers, path lanterns and their orange glowing pools. Keep ONLY FIVE individual outdoor torch flames in the entire enormous landscape: a pair beside the main castle entrance, one beside a village tavern entrance, one beside a lower gate, and one beside a distant small watchtower entrance. All other exterior torch flames and freestanding glowing orange points must be removed.
Especially remove EVERY torch or lantern around the perimeter of the empty central square grass clearing. Remove all rows of lights along roads, bridges, retaining walls, castle terraces, farm fields, stairs and hill paths. Those surfaces should be natural dim stone, wood, earth and foliage, with NO repeated glow points. No strings of lights. Some softly illuminated windows inside buildings may remain, but they are subtle warm rectangles, not exterior flames. The castle may have a few welcoming warm windows and the villages an occasional warm window.
Preserve EVERYTHING else: same portrait composition, standard empty square grass lot at the exact same coordinates and size, same hill shapes, castles, buildings, trees, paths, farm fields, tiny lower-right millpond, greatly reduced water, sky and remaining sunset sunlight. Maintain blue-gray dusk shadows with a little sunset glow on highest towers, readable detail. Do not brighten it back into daytime or make it pitch black. This is a quieter, restrained naturally dim hillside kingdom with a handful of torches, not a brightly lit festival. No Christmas decor. No text or UI.

Preserve the portrait aspect ratio, enormous scale of castles and surrounding settlements, detailed isometric game-render style, and the SMALL COMPLETELY EMPTY flat grassy building clearing at the same location (center approximately 51% imagewidth and45.5%imageheight). Time of day: dim early evening, just after sunset with a little warm sunlight still touching the highest towers and hilltops. Lanterns and warm windows throughout the settlements. Make the lit torchlight contrast convincingly against the dimmer hillside environment. Keep fine stone/wood/foliage detail and natural soft lighting. Dense cottages, trees, small outlying castles, windmills, watchtowers, barns and farm terraces fill the rest of the portrait. No snow or Christmas decorations here. No text, labels, border, UI or grid.

christmas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background artwork for an isometric mobile fantasy village-building game. Create a highly detailed portrait 1024 by 2048 landscape, rich premium 3D game-render finish.
CHRISTMAS KINGDOM: an enormous magical Christmas realm built across snowy floating mountain terraces. The upper left is dominated by a towering fairytale white-stone castle with deep crimson and emerald steep roofs, gilded spires, wreaths, snowy parapets, warm amber windows and strings of golden Christmas lights. A gigantic lush evergreen Christmas tree towers over the upper right terraces, with a brilliant gold star, tiny warm lights, red and gold baubles, ribbons and snowy branches. This tree and the castle each dwarf the little central playable plot. Dozens of cozy red-roofed timber cottages and gingerbread-inspired stone workshops fill the lower half and sides, chimney smoke, festive market stalls with red awnings, garlands across cobbled lanes, toy workshops, wrapped gifts, sleighs parked beside stables, a grand clock tower, lantern bridges, frozen aqueducts, icicles, blue ice waterfalls and a frozen harbor with festive sailing ships. Dense fir forests mixed with cottages and rocky cliffs, small reindeer in peripheral snowy glades, little snowmen beside distant paths. Floating snowy satellite islands and aurora glow near the perimeter. Romantic blue-hour twilight, deep blue snowy shadows balanced with abundant warm gold window and holiday lights. Cheerful grand Christmas fantasy, not dark horror.
CRITICAL GAME COMPOSITION: at exactly 50% image width and 50% image height leave ONE SMALL, FLAT, COMPLETELY EMPTY clean snow-covered square seen in isometric perspective as a diamond. Its full width is 24% of image width, its full height is 9.5% of image height. Vertices approximately top(50%,45.25%), right(62%,50%), bottom(50%,54.75%), left(38%,50%). Keep all buildings, trees, gifts, paths, fences, animals, ice, tall shadows and decorations OUTSIDE this empty snow diamond. No border, no grid, no outline, no paths crossing it. Softly blend the snow around its edges. The whole little square occupies about 1% of the artwork. Everything around it is huge and densely populated. The player's village will be drawn over this little clearing by the game. Do NOT draw the player's village. Do not let the castle or giant Christmas tree overlap it.
Camera: elevated three-quarter isometric aerial view looking down about 50 degrees. Coherent detailed stone, wood, snowy foliage, soft realistic shadows, sharp miniature-world detail, excellent readable silhouettes. Whole enormous scenic world fills the portrait canvas, only a little sky near its edges. No labels, lettering, logos, UI, or text. Original architecture and characters. This is a finished richly detailed game world background, not a poster or concept sheet.

santa.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent-background game sprite for a detailed isometric fantasy Christmas kingdom.
Create one complete miniature Santa Claus flying in his beautiful crimson red and gold sleigh pulled by TWO reindeer in tandem, all fully visible. Santa is a warm cheerful older man with a fluffy white beard, traditional red fur-trimmed coat and Santa hat, seated securely holding the reins. A sack of wrapped colorful Christmas presents is secured behind Santa. Sleigh has elegant gilded curled runners and sculpted red sides. Two anatomically plausible brown reindeer with clear branched antlers, cream neck ruffs, red leather harnesses and small golden bells pull it ahead through the air, legs outstretched in a graceful flying stride. Fine leather reins connect the sleigh to both reindeer.
Composition: wide horizontal, sleigh on left, reindeer ahead toward right. Elevated three-quarter isometric view, looking downward about 40 degrees, facing screen-right; we see Santa's face from a flattering front-side angle and the tops of the sleigh and reindeer. Whole group centered with generous transparent padding on every side. Nothing clipped. Coherent 3D rendered/painterly game art, detailed warm materials with soft blue-hour highlights that suit a snowy fantasy castle, clear crisp readable silhouette. A game-ready cutout, not a scene, not a photograph, not a flat vector. No ground, no landscape, no background, no oval backdrop, no snowfall or particle trail, no contact shadow or drop shadow, no words, text, labels, UI, or logo. Actual transparent alpha background. One sleigh and precisely two reindeer only.
